title: Dark Chess Piece of the Imperial Court
next_chapter_hook: The cooperation conditions offered by the imperial envoy far exceeded Chen Ji's expectations, and just as he was about to make a decision, a familiar figure emerged indistinctly among the imperial procession—the silhouette that had been missing for years actually overlapped with the memory of Chen Nian.

text.content: The eerie whispers from the depths of the Tianji Record chilled Chen Ji's spine like ice water, while Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly stopped, as if severed by some invisible force. Chen Ji's fingertips went numb, and his Heavenly Fate Value unexpectedly dropped by five points—the Tianji Record was warning him. He looked up sharply to find the rune formations on the walls of the secret chamber flickering in an unsettling rhythm, seemingly resonating with a distant summoning. "It's here." Ye Qing's voice dropped low, as the Demonic Path mist had already gathered in her palm. Su Qingyao's sword was three inches out of its sheath, the cold light reflecting her tightly clenched jaw. The three stood back to back in silent understanding, their gazes fixed on the chamber's entrance—where the air was twisting, and a completely black token was slowly emerging from the Void. The imperial dragon emblem glowed with a chilling golden light in the darkness.

dialogue.content: "The imperial court's nose is quite sharp." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, his voice pitched perfectly to be heard by the approaching figure. He didn't withdraw his hand from the Tianji Record; instead, in front of the token, he deducted another five points from his Heavenly Fate Value. The Tianji Record's vision sharpened: the visitor was no ordinary envoy, but the legendary "Shadow Minister" of the imperial court, the leader of the dark forces directly under the Emperor. This meant the imperial court valued this chess game far more than he had initially estimated. "Ye Qing, stand down. We have a guest." Chen Ji dismissed the situation casually, as if the imperial envoy's arrival was merely something he had anticipated all along.

The Shadow Minister's voice, aged yet full of vitality, resonated through the Void where the token hovered. A figure in dark imperial robes stepped from the warped light, emerging from the Void. The old man's face was withered, but his eyes held a profound depth, as if concealing half the secret history of the imperial court. "The old one carries the Emperor's orders, specifically to discuss a mutually beneficial matter with the young master." The Shadow Minister's gaze swept over Ye Qing and Su Qingyao, lingering briefly on Ye Qing—the Holy Sect's Saint Maiden, a wanted criminal ranked third on the imperial court's most wanted list. "This matter concerns the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, and even more so, your sister who has been missing for many years."

text.content: Chen Nian. The name pierced Chen Ji's most vulnerable point like a precise needle. His pupils contracted sharply, but the next moment restored to normal. His composure, so still it deceived even Su Qingyao beside him, couldn't hide the whiteness of his fingertips pressing on the Tianji Record—he had taken note. The imperial court knew of Chen Nian's existence, which meant the Holy Sect, the imperial court, and even the Eye of Heavenly Secrets had already extended their tendrils toward his weakness from the very beginning of his schemes. "The Shadow Minister's intelligence network is quite thorough." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "What does the imperial court want?" The Shadow Minister stroked his withered beard, his smile not reaching his eyes: "Simple—use the young master's hand to break the destiny game the Eye of Heavenly Secrets has laid upon the mortal world. In return, the imperial court is willing to return your sister safely to your side."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji rose slowly, his movements socomposed as if strolling in his own backyard. He walked around the Shadow Minister to the chamber's window, his back to the three others, his voice low yet clear: "Shadow Minister, do you know what the Eye of Heavenly Secrets truly is?" Without waiting for a reply, he continued: "It is an existence beyond sects, beyond the imperial court, even beyond the cultivation world itself. You think the imperial court is playing a game of chess against it? No, you are merely two pieces on the board with slightly more weight." He turned around, his gaze sharp as a blade. "Use my hand to break the game? Does His Majesty think this chess piece of his can endure more折腾 than your imperial court, or... is the imperial court itself the third hand the Eye of Heavenly Secrets deliberately placed beside me?"

text.content: The temperature in the secret chamber seemed to plummet several degrees. The Shadow Minister's smile froze for an instant, then transformed into a meaningful sigh: "Young Master Chen is truly worthy of being the Tianji Record's inheritor. Indeed, His Majesty does know some of the... origins of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets." He drew a yellowed silk scroll from his sleeve, its patterns strikingly similar to those on the Tianji Record's cover. "This is a relic left by the founding emperor of the imperial court, recording the contracts between successive emperors and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Young master, please look—" The scroll unfurled, revealing an intricate totem, and at the very center of the totem was a name that shook Chen Ji's very being: the Chen Family.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's spine stiffened momentarily. He stared at that name, the visions from the Tianji Record churning violently in his mind—he finally understood the meaning of Mo Xiansheng's words about "miscalculation." He had always thought himself the chess player, the strategist, never once considering that the Chen Family itself was the most crucial piece on this chessboard. "My Chen Family... what connection does it have with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?" His voice was hoarse, rarely showing a hint of loss of control. Ye Qing and Su Qingyao exchanged a glance, both seeing shock in each other's eyes—this was the first time they had witnessed Chen Ji's composure shatter. The Shadow Minister satisfiedly put away the silk scroll. "So young master now understands? You and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets are fundamentally of the same origin. The inheritors chosen by the Tianji Record have always been of Chen bloodline." He paused. "And your sister, Chen Nian, is precisely the Heavenly Fate Lock Key the Eye of Heavenly Secrets uses to constrain you."

text.content: "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Chen Ji repeated these four characters in a low voice, each syllable seeming to be squeezed from between his teeth. He recalled the blurred visions every time he used the Tianji Record, the foresight that remained unclear because of Chen Nian's existence—turns out it wasn't the Tianji Record that was incomplete, but someone deliberately shielding his vision. Su Qingyao suddenly spoke: "Shadow Minister, you say the imperial court wants to use Chen Ji's hand to break the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' game, but according to my knowledge, the imperial court has been cooperating with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets for a thousand years. If that's the case, why would you turn against it now?" This was precisely the critical question Chen Ji wanted to ask but hadn't had time to. The Shadow Minister fell silent for a moment, his gaze briefly showing rare gravity: "Because the Eye of Heavenly Secrets... is no longer satisfied with being a chess player."

choice.prompt: The imperial envoys revealed shocking truths, the situation had exceeded Chen Ji's预设 chessboard. He must reassess the true positions of all parties in this power game.

choices.text: Play along to extract more intelligence

choices.visible_cost: May owe the imperial court a favor
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The imperial court may use this to bind Chen Ji as a chess piece

text.content: A profound smile spread across Chen Ji's face, a smile that made the Shadow Minister narrow his eyes slightly. "Since the Shadow Minister shows such sincerity, Mr. Chen is not an unreasonable man." He walked to the desk, personally pouring tea for the Shadow Minister, his movementscomposed as if the other party were not an imperial power but an old friend. "However... before discussing cooperation, Mr. Chen has an unreasonable request." His fingertip tapped lightly on the desk. "Where is Chen Nian now? I want to see her and confirm she is safe. Is that too much to ask?" The Shadow Minister accepted the teacup, a flash of appreciation crossing his eyes: "The young master is indeed a wise man. Your sister is very safe now, but I must be direct—before the young master proves his sincerity, she cannot meet you."

choices.description: Show the imperial court the information Chen Ji already possesses, proving he is not a chess piece to be manipulated.
choices.visible_cost: May grow hostile with the imperial court
choices.visible_reward: Seize the negotiating initiative, forcing the imperial court to reveal more chips
choices.risk_hint: The imperial court may shift to support other forces

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst out laughing, that laughter sounding particularly harsh in the silent chamber. "Shadow Minister, do you truly think Mr. Chen is a three-year-old child?" He raised his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment manifesting in his palm, the light flowing upon it causing the Shadow Minister's expression to change dramatically—that light faintly revealed the outline of the imperial palace, and a terrifying scene: beneath the emperor's throne, countless chains bound a struggling figure, and that figure's owner was being eroded inch by inch by the will of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. "I have already seen it." Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold. "The reason His Majesty is so eager to deal with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is not because it wants to overturn the chessboard, but because it has already reached for the dragon throne. The imperial court... is merely the next Chen Family."

choices.text: Retreat to advance, propose exchange conditions
choices.description: Do not respond directly, first demand the imperial court prove its sincerity—release Chen Nian or provide substantial assistance.
choices.visible_reward: Test the true intentions of the Empire's cooperation, accumulating leverage for subsequent negotiations
choices.risk_hint: The Empire may consider Chen Ji lacks sincere intention to cooperate

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he slowly walked back to the Tianji Record, his fingertips gently brushing across the yellowed pages. His silence made Ying Xiang frown slightly, and also had Ye Qing and Su Qingyao's hearts in their throats. After a long while, Chen Ji spoke, his voice calm without a trace of fluctuation: 'Cooperation is possible. But Chen has one condition—let me see Chen Nian first.' He raised his head, his gaze fixed directly on Ying Xiang. 'Not a portrait, not a token, but the real person. If the Empire truly has sincerity, let me personally confirm she is safe. As for the cooperation afterward...' A meaningful smile curved at the corner of his mouth. 'That depends on how much... trust the Empire can give Chen.' A complex light flickered in Ying Xiang's eyes: 'The young master is indeed cautious. Very well, this old man speaks for His Majesty and accepts.'

dialogue.content: Ying Xiang suddenly stepped forward, lowering his voice: 'Does the young master know why the Eye of Heavenly Secrets chose the Chen bloodline as the vessel for the Tianji Record?' Chen Ji did not answer, merely watching him silently. Ying Xiang continued: 'Because the Chen family... is inherently part of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. A thousand years ago, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets split itself, injecting part of its will into the Chen family's ancestor, using this as its eyes for walking among mortals. And the Tianji Record is merely a tool it uses to reclaim this portion of will.' He paused. 'Your sister is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key because she also carries Chen blood—moreover, pure blood untainted by the Tianji Record.' Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly. He thought of Mo Xiansheng, of those truths deliberately concealed. The Tianji Record had been deceiving him all along. From the beginning, it was no golden finger but a chain leading to the abyss.

text.content: Just then, Ye Qing suddenly spoke: 'Lord Ying Xiang, I have one thing I don't understand.' Her voice was cold, yet carried the sharp edge unique to a Demon Path Saint: 'You said the Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to reclaim Chen Ji's will, but since it is an existence that transcends everything, why doesn't it act directly and instead uses the Empire's hands?' Ying Xiang's gaze fell on Ye Qing, seemingly assessing her worth. After a moment, he slowly said: 'Because it cannot.' This sentence stunned everyone present. 'Although the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is a transcendent consciousness, it is bound by some even more ancient law—it cannot directly interfere in mortal affairs, or it will trigger Heavenly Retribution.' A bitter smile appeared at the corner of Ying Xiang's mouth. 'This is why it needs the Tianji Record, needs the Sects, needs the Empire... needs countless pawns to act on its behalf.'

choice.prompt: The situation grows increasingly complex. Chen Ji must find a path to survival in the gap between the Empire and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

choices.text: Form an alliance with the Empire to jointly oppose the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.description: Since the Empire and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets have conflicting interests, the enemy of my enemy is my friend.
choices.visible_cost: May be exploited by the Empire
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Empire's resource support, increasing leverage against the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.risk_hint: The Empire may have ulterior motives

dialogue.content: Chen Ji mused for a moment, then finally nodded: 'Very well. I agree to cooperate with the Empire. But let me make something clear—if the Empire dares to use Chen Nian as leverage or coercion, Chen would rather risk the Tianji Record's backlash than let the Empire experience what it means when there is no victory for either side.' Upon hearing this, Ying Xiang did not get angry; instead, he laughed and applauded: 'The young master is indeed straightforward! This old man will immediately report to His Majesty, and within three days, there will be a reply.' His form began to dissipate, but before leaving, he suddenly turned back. 'By the way, young master... your sister asked this old man to bring you a message.' Chen Ji's heart suddenly clenched. Ying Xiang's voice seemed to come from an extreme distance: 'She said—Brother, I've been waiting for you for so long.'

choices.text: Reverse the board, use the Empire to deal with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.description: Accept cooperation, but secretly include the Empire in the chess game, letting the two forces exhaust each other.
choices.visible_cost: Need to deal with multiple forces simultaneously
choices.visible_reward: Reap the benefits as a bystander
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, will offend both the Empire and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets simultaneously

text.content: Chen Ji calculated rapidly in his heart. The Empire wants to use him against the Eye of Heavenly Secrets; the Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to reclaim the will within him—neither side is kind. But this also means he can use the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' hand to weaken the Empire, then use the Empire's strength to drain the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. As for Chen Nian... he must meet her in person to confirm whether she is a victim or another arranged piece. 'Lord Ying Xiang,' Chen Ji suddenly spoke, 'Before discussing cooperation details, Chen wants to know one thing—how long has Chen Nian been in the Empire's hands?' Ying Xiang's footsteps paused: 'Three years.' Three years. Exactly the time since he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—this was no coincidence. From the beginning, his obtaining the Tianji Record, the Empire's involvement, Chen Nian's disappearance—everything had been arranged meticulously. 'Interesting.' He murmured, a cold smile appearing at the corner of his mouth. 'It seems this chess game is far larger than I imagined.'

choices.description: Before making a decision, demand Ying Xiang disclose more intelligence about the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and the Empire.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence to provide a basis for subsequent decision-making
choices.risk_hint: Ying Xiang may grow impatient and unwilling to disclose too much

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly stepped in front of Chen Ji, her gaze like a sword stabbing toward Ying Xiang: 'Lord Ying Xiang, forgive my frankness—the information you revealed today is truly shocking. I need to confirm one thing.' Her voice was clear and cold. 'Since the Eye of Heavenly Secrets wants to reclaim Chen Ji's will, why doesn't it directly erase him? With its power, even with the law's constraints, acting secretly would not be impossible. Does its choice to have the Empire step forward mean... it cannot pinpoint Chen Ji's specific location?' Ying Xiang's expression changed slightly. This reaction gave Su Qingyao her answer. She turned to look at Chen Ji, a hint of heartache flashing in her eyes: 'Chen Ji, the aura of the Tianji Record is deliberately concealed, isn't it? Every time you use the Tianji Record to foresee the future, you are exposing yourself—and it, has been tracking these traces to find you.'

text.content: Shadow Minister's form had mostly dissipated, but upon hearing Su Qingyao's analysis, he remarkably stopped in his tracks. "This young lady is indeed perceptive." His voice drifted from the Void. "Correct, the Heavenly Eye cannot directly locate the holder of the Tianji Record. But it has another method—" His final words fell like a heavy hammer. "Your sister, Chen Nian, is a nail it has buried beside the Tianji Record. As long as Chen Nian approaches Chen Ji, the Heavenly Eye can lock onto the target by following her aura. For three years, your sister has been relatively safe in the Imperial Court's hands. But once she returns to the young master's side..." He didn't finish, but the implication was abundantly clear—Chen Nian was both a lock and a beacon. If Chen Ji took his sister back, he might as well hand the Tianji Record to the Heavenly Eye himself.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent. This was the greatest predicament he had encountered since beginning his scheme—saving his sister would expose him; not saving her, what was the point of cultivating the Tianji Record? Ye Qing seemed to want to say something, but Chen Ji raised his hand to stop her. He took a deep breath, and that familiar faint smile reappeared on his face, as if everything was under control. "Shadow Minister," his voice was terrifyingly calm, "Chen has a plan that can resolve this situation." He walked to the window, moonlight outlining his gaunt profile. "Since the Heavenly Eye wants to locate me through Chen Nian, I'll give it a false signal—have the Imperial Court release news that Chen Nian has died. The Heavenly Eye will inevitably shift its gaze away from Chen Nian and seek other methods of positioning. And during this period..." He turned around, a fierce gleam flickering in his eyes. "I will personally go retrieve Chen Nian, making her completely disappear from the Heavenly Eye's perception."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji put forth a bold plan, and the Imperial Court's attitude will determine the next direction.

choices.text: Agree to this plan, the Imperial Court will cooperate in releasing false news
choices.description: This is a high-stakes gamble, but if successful, it can simultaneously deceive the Heavenly Eye and rescue Chen Nian.
choices.visible_cost: If the plan fails, it will be total defeat
choices.visible_reward: Completely escape the Heavenly Eye's tracking
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may see through the scheme

dialogue.content: Shadow Minister's form had completely dissipated, but his laughter echoed in the secret chamber: "Brilliant! The young master is indeed a wonderful person! This old man will immediately report to His Majesty. Within three days, the Imperial Court will release news—Chen Nian has died of crimes in the Imperial Prison." The laughter faded away. "As for how the young master retrieves the person... that will be the young master's ability. This old man only reminds you: the Holy Sect has recently taken great interest in your sister. If you intend to act, sooner is better than later." The secret chamber returned to silence. Ye Qing and Su Qingyao exchanged glances, both seeing complex emotions in each other's eyes—Chen Ji's plan wascrazed, but if successful, they would completely transform from passive defense to active attack. "Chen Ji," Su Qingyao whispered, "Are you really going to gamble on this?"

choices.text: The plan is too risky, find another way
choices.description: Chen Nian's matter must be considered carefully, cannot fall into greater danger due to momentary impulse.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian may continue to be coveted by the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: The Imperial Court may withdraw cooperation as a result

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao grabbed Chen Ji's wrist, her grip force making him slightly frown. "Chen Ji, calm down." Her voice rarely carried a hint of urgency. "Chen Nian is your sister, I understand your feelings, but this plan has too many loopholes—why would the Imperial Court cooperate with your act? What if the news leaks? The Heavenly Eye won't be fooled; instead, it will accelerate the pursuit." Ye Qing also nodded in agreement: "Sister Su makes a valid point. Young master, acting rashly will only alert the enemy. Better we first secretly investigate Chen Nian's specific location, wait until we've gauged the Holy Sect and Imperial Court's cards before making plans." Chen Ji fell silent. He knew they were right, but the thought of Chen Nian suffering in those people's hands made it impossible for him to maintain his usual composure. After a long while, he slowly unclenched his tightly held fist: "...Alright. Give me three days."

choices.text: First agree with the Imperial Court, secretly prepare backup plans
choices.description: 表面上同意计划，实则暗中布置保险，以防皇朝或天道之眼反扑。
choices.visible_cost: Need to guard against multiple forces simultaneously
choices.risk_hint: Once the plan is exposed, all trust will be lost

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, but something in his eyes made Ye Qing sense an异样—that was the gleam he only had when plotting. "Shadow Minister's proposal, Chen accepts." His voice was calm. "In three days, please have the Imperial Court act according to plan." After Shadow Minister's aura completely faded, Chen Ji suddenly turned to Ye Qing: "Saint Ye Qing, can your Demonic Path mist conceal a person's aura, making her completely disappear from the Heavenly Eye's perception?" Ye Qing narrowed her eyes: "I can, but only for one hour. And..." She paused. "That person would need to actively cooperate, sealing their own consciousness within the mist." Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed softly: "Excellent. This matter, only Chen Nian can do." He gazed at the night sky outside the window, a complex gleam flickering in his eyes. "It seems it's time to let my sister know the truth."

A commotion suddenly erupted outside the secret chamber, followed by a familiar aged voice: "Chen Ji, you come out here for this old man!" It was Ling Yuan. The old sect master of Tianqing Sect visiting late at night clearly had sensed the刚才的异常. Chen Ji signaled for Ye Qing and Su Qingyao to retreat into the hidden chamber, while he unhurriedly opened the door. Ling Yuan stood outside, his gaze like lightning, seemingly wanting to see through Chen Ji. "That aura just now... was from someone of the Imperial Court?" His voice suppressed some emotion. "Chen Ji, what on earth are you up to? This old man let you participate in the Three Sects Competition, not for you to collude with the Imperial Court!" Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged as he respectfully bowed: "Sect Master, please calm your anger. This disciple was merely discussing some... cooperation matters with the Imperial Court envoy." Ling Yuan's gaze grew increasingly gloomy: "What cooperation?"

Chen Ji raised his head, directly meeting Ling Yuan's fathomless eyes. Under the moonlight, their gazes clashed in mid-air, as if silent sparks were flying. "Sect Master," Chen Ji's voice was calm yet carried an undeniable authority, "Everything this disciple has done is for the future of Tianqing Sect. The Imperial Court is willing to provide resources to support our participation in the Three Sects Competition—isn't this a good thing for the sect?" Ling Yuan's brow slightly furrowed. He stared at Chen Ji for a long while, then suddenly coldly laughed: "A fine 'future of the sect.' Chen Ji, you think this old man is a three-year-old child?" He stepped forward, lowering his voice. "What are you really scheming with the Imperial Court? This old man warns you—if you dare harm Tianqing Sect's interests, even if this old man must sacrifice cultivation regression, I will expel you from the sect!"

Chen Ji did not back down, but instead met Ling Yuan's gaze and smiled faintly: "The sect master teaches wisely. This disciple admits his mistake." His manner was respectful and impeccable, but a cold glint that only Ling Yuan could detect flashed in those eyes—a challenge from one chess player to another. Ling Yuan's expression changed slightly, then recovered calm. He deeply glanced at Chen Ji one more time, then turned and left. "At the Three Sects Competition three days later, you had better give this old man a satisfactory explanation." His voice drifted from the night air, carrying an unnoticeable killing intent. Chen Ji closed the door and leaned against it, the smile on his face slowly fading. He knew Ling Yuan had begun to suspect him. More troubling was that this old sect master's background was probably far more complex than what appeared on the surface...

Ye Qing and Su Qingyao walked out from the hidden chamber, both with unhappy expressions. "Ling Yuan the old fox probably already guessed what we're scheming with the Imperial Court." Ye Qing frowned. Su Qingyao noticed another detail: "Did you notice? Ling Yuan's aura just now was a bit off. His Spiritual Energy fluctuation... seems at least thirty percent stronger than before." Chen Ji nodded, a solemn gleam flickering in his eyes. He had just used the Tianji Record to secretly observe Ling Yuan and discovered that this old sect master's body was actually entwined with a wisp of extremely faint black mist—that was the aura of the Demonic Path, yet distinctly different from Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist. More bizarrely, the source of this black aura actually pointed toward the depths of the Tianji Record... "It seems," Chen Ji murmured to himself, "This game is far more chaotic than I imagined."

At this moment, from the depths of the Tianji Record came Mr. Mo's voice once more, this time carrying a rare note of praise: "Well done. You've finally begun to see the boundaries of the chessboard." Chen Ji's heart trembled, and he quickly immersed his consciousness into the Tianji Record. Mr. Mo's wisp of soul phantom materialized on the surface of the first page, his features even more blurred than before, as if he might dissipate at any moment. "The plan is feasible, but you've overlooked one thing—" Mr. Mo repeated his previous words, paused, then continued, "Ling Yuan is no ordinary sect master. He was Chen Xuan's fellow disciple from the same teacher. After being defeated by Chen Xuan, he harbored resentment and defected to..." Before the words could finish, Mr. Mo's figure violently twisted, and an imposing, cold consciousness forcibly intruded into the Tianji Record's space. "Enough." The voice thundered like divine wrath, "Inheritor of the Tianji Record, some truths are not meant for you to touch yet." This was the voice of the Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—it had appeared directly.

The Heavenly Eye's will was like an invisible giant hand, fiercely gripping Chen Ji's soul. He felt his consciousness being stripped away bit by bit, and countless诡异 runes appeared on the pages of the Tianji Record—those were seals used to封印 memory. Chen Ji struggled desperately, yet against absolute power, he had no means of resistance. Just as he was about to be erased of this memory, a familiar force erupted from the jade pendant Chen Nian had left him, temporarily repelling the Heavenly Eye's will. "Interesting." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of surprise, "So you still kept a trump card. However... this protection won't save you for long." Its voice gradually faded away, "On the day of the Three Sect Competition in three days, this one will watch you personally. Then, all the pieces will return to their positions." The Tianji Record's space returned to peace, but Chen Ji knew—the storm had only just begun.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, finding himself drenched in cold sweat. Ye Qing and Su Qingyao were gazing at him anxiously, clearly unaware of what had just transpired. "Chen Ji, are you alright?" Su Qingyao's voice carried worry. Chen Ji waved his hand, signaling he was fine, but his gaze had become unprecedentedly grave. The Heavenly Eye appearing voluntarily meant it had begun to panic. The Three Sect Competition, the imperial court's involvement, Ling Yuan's true identity, Chen Nian's situation... all clues were pointing toward an earth-shattering truth. And he must find the key to breaking the situation before the real storm arrived. "Three days," he murmured, "only three days left." Outside the window, the east was already turning white. A new day was about to begin, and his showdown with destiny would usher in its most critical moment.
